title: Adding and Subtracting Two-Digit Numbers
seo_title: Grade 2 Adding and Subtracting Two-Digit Numbers Worksheets (TEKS 2.4B)
standard_text: 2.4B add up to four two-digit numbers and subtract two-digit numbers using mental strategies and algorithms based on knowledge of place value and properties of operations
meta_desc: Free Grade 2 worksheets for Texas TEKS 2.4B: add and subtract two-digit numbers with base-ten blocks and regrouping, add up to four two-digit numbers and missing numbers. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Add or subtract the ones, then the tens. Regroup when you need to.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Add the ones, then the tens. If there are 10 or more ones, regroup 10 ones as 1 ten.
  • To subtract, if there are not enough ones, regroup 1 ten as 10 ones.
  • To add several numbers, look for pairs that make 10 or 100.
  • Check subtraction by adding.

Examples

Example

47 + 38

7 + 8 = 15: write 5, regroup 1 ten

4 + 3 + 1 = 8 tens

Answer: 85

Example

62 − 27

Regroup: 5 tens 12 ones

12 − 7 = 5, 5 − 2 = 3

Answer: 35

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting to regroup15 ones = 1 ten and 5 ones.
Subtracting the smaller digit from the bigger62 − 27: regroup, do not do 7 − 2.
Adding tens as ones4 tens + 3 tens = 7 tens = 70.

items.e: 19 + 1 = 20. Then 57 − 1 = 56. So 19 + 57 = 20 + 56 = 76. Moving 1 does not change the total.

sets.title: Add three or four two-digit numbers

items.q: What is 17 + 28 + 13?
items.e: Look for ones that make 10: 7 + 3 = 10. So 17 + 13 = 30. Then 30 + 28 = 58.

items.q: What is 38 + 16 + 12?
items.e: Look for ones that make 10: 8 + 2 = 10. So 38 + 12 = 50. Then 50 + 16 = 66.

items.q: What is 19 + 28 + 21?
items.e: Look for ones that make 10: 9 + 1 = 10. So 19 + 21 = 40. Then 40 + 28 = 68.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Ones: 5 + 7 + 4 = 16. Write 6 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 2 + 2 + 2 = 6, plus the regrouped 1 ten = 7. Answer: 76.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Ones: 2 + 7 + 1 = 10. Write 0 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 2 + 2 + 2 = 6, plus the regrouped 1 ten = 7. Answer: 70.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Ones: 3 + 4 + 8 = 15. Write 5 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 2 + 1 + 3 = 6, plus the regrouped 1 ten = 7. Answer: 75.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Ones: 7 + 5 + 3 + 2 = 17. Write 7 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 5, plus the regrouped 1 ten = 6. Answer: 67. Remember to add all 4 numbers.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Ones: 4 + 5 + 6 + 1 = 16. Write 6 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 2 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 7, plus the regrouped 1 ten = 8. Answer: 86. Remember to add all 4 numbers.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Ones: 5 + 5 + 3 + 9 = 22. Write 2 and regroup 2 tens. Tens: 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 5, plus the regrouped 2 tens = 7. Answer: 72. Remember to add all 4 numbers.

items.q: Add.
items.e: Ones: 7 + 8 + 8 + 4 = 27. Write 7 and regroup 2 tens. Tens: 2 + 2 + 1 + 2 = 7, plus the regrouped 2 tens = 9. Answer: 97. Remember to add all 4 numbers.

items.q: Marcus has 38 stickers. His friend gives him 25 more. How many stickers does Marcus have now?
items.e: Getting more means add. Ones: 8 + 5 = 13. Write 3 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 3 + 2 + 1 = 6. Answer: 63.

items.q: A bus has 52 seats. 27 children get on, and each child takes a seat. How many seats are empty?
items.e: Take the full seats away from all the seats: subtract. Ones: 2 − 7 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 12 − 7 = 5. Tens: 4 − 2 = 2. Answer: 25. Check: 25 + 27 = 52.

items.q: Elijah picks 64 apples. He gives away 29 of them. How many apples are left?
items.e: Giving away means subtract. Ones: 4 − 9 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 14 − 9 = 5. Tens: 5 − 2 = 3. Answer: 35. Check: 35 + 29 = 64.

items.q: Grace read 23 pages on Monday, 18 pages on Tuesday and 31 pages on Wednesday. How many pages did she read in all?
items.e: Add all three days. Ones: 3 + 8 + 1 = 12. Write 2 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 2 + 1 + 3 = 6, plus the regrouped 1 ten = 7. Answer: 72.

items.q: The class has 45 crayons. They need 80 crayons. How many more crayons do they need?
items.e: Find the missing part: 45 + ☐ = 80. Count up: 45 + 5 = 50, then 50 + 30 = 80. 5 + 30 = 35. Check: 45 + 35 = 80.

items.q: Ximena has 71 cents. Ethan has 46 cents. How many more cents does Ximena have than Ethan?
items.e: How many more means find the difference: subtract. Ones: 1 − 6 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 11 − 6 = 5. Tens: 6 − 4 = 2. Answer: 25. Check: 25 + 46 = 71.

items.q: A garden has 17 red flowers, 26 yellow flowers, 14 pink flowers and 22 white flowers. How many flowers are there?
items.e: Add all 4 colors. Ones: 7 + 6 + 4 + 2 = 19. Write 9 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 1 + 2 + 1 + 2 = 6, plus the regrouped 1 ten = 7. Answer: 79.

items.q: Some birds sit in a tree. 18 birds fly away. Now 35 birds are left. How many birds were in the tree at first?
items.e: The birds that left plus the birds that stayed make all the birds: add. Ones: 5 + 8 = 13. Write 3 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 3 + 1 + 1 = 5. Answer: 53. Check: 53 − 18 = 35.

items.q: Josiah has 90 cents. He buys a pencil for 36 cents. How much money does he have left?
items.e: Spending money means subtract. Ones: 0 − 6 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 10 − 6 = 4. Tens: 8 − 3 = 5. Answer: 54. Check: 54 + 36 = 90.

items.q: A bakery makes 48 muffins in the morning and 37 muffins in the afternoon. How many muffins does it make in all?
items.e: In all means add. Ones: 8 + 7 = 15. Write 5 and regroup 1 ten. Tens: 4 + 3 + 1 = 8. Answer: 85.

items.q: Isaac says 63 − 28 = 45. Is he right?
items.e: Check by adding: 45 + 28 = 73, not 63. So 45 is wrong. Ones: 3 − 8 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 13 − 8 = 5. Tens: 5 − 2 = 3. Answer: 35. Check: 35 + 28 = 63.

items.q: Subtract.
items.e: Ones: 0 − 2 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 10 − 2 = 8. Tens: 8 − 3 = 5. Answer: 58. Check: 58 + 32 = 90. Or count up: 32 + 8 = 40, then 40 + 50 = 90. 8 + 50 = 58.

items.q: Subtract.
items.e: Ones: 0 − 9 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 10 − 9 = 1. Tens: 5 − 1 = 4. Answer: 41. Check: 41 + 19 = 60. Or count up: 19 + 1 = 20, then 20 + 40 = 60. 1 + 40 = 41.

items.q: What number goes in the box? ☐ + 39 = 53
items.e: Use subtraction: 53 − 39 = ☐. Ones: 3 − 9 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 13 − 9 = 4. Tens: 4 − 3 = 1. Answer: 14. Check: 14 + 39 = 53.

items.q: What number goes in the box? ☐ + 35 = 71
items.e: Use subtraction: 71 − 35 = ☐. Ones: 1 − 5 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 11 − 5 = 6. Tens: 6 − 3 = 3. Answer: 36. Check: 36 + 35 = 71.

items.q: What is 60 − 49?
items.e: Ones: 0 − 9 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 10 − 9 = 1. Tens: 5 − 4 = 1. Answer: 11. Check: 11 + 49 = 60. Or count up: 49 + 1 = 50, then 50 + 10 = 60. 1 + 10 = 11.

items.q: What number goes in the box? ☐ + 37 = 53
items.e: Use subtraction: 53 − 37 = ☐. Ones: 3 − 7 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 13 − 7 = 6. Tens: 4 − 3 = 1. Answer: 16. Check: 16 + 37 = 53.

items.q: What number goes in the box? 62 − ☐ = 46
items.e: Think: 62 take away what number leaves 46? Find 62 − 46. Ones: 2 − 6 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 12 − 6 = 6. Tens: 5 − 4 = 1. Answer: 16. Check: 62 − 16 = 46.

items.q: Carlos found 72 − 35 = 37. Which addition checks his answer?
items.e: Add the answer to the number you took away: 37 + 35 = 72. You get back 72, so the answer is right.

items.q: What number goes in the box? 39 + ☐ = 71
items.e: Use subtraction: 71 − 39 = ☐. Ones: 1 − 9 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 11 − 9 = 2. Tens: 6 − 3 = 3. Answer: 32. Check: 39 + 32 = 71.

items.q: Zoe found 64 − 29 = 35. Which addition checks her answer?
items.e: Add the answer to the number you took away: 35 + 29 = 64. You get back 64, so the answer is right.

items.q: Ethan says 74 − 38 = 44. Is he right?
items.e: Check by adding: 44 + 38 = 82, not 74. So 44 is wrong. Ones: 4 − 8 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 14 − 8 = 6. Tens: 6 − 3 = 3. Answer: 36. Check: 36 + 38 = 74.

items.q: What is 100 − 46?
items.e: 100 is 10 tens. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: now 9 tens and 10 ones. Ones: 10 − 6 = 4. Tens: 9 − 4 = 5. Answer: 54. Check: 54 + 46 = 100. Or count up: 46 + 4 = 50, then 50 + 50 = 100. 4 + 50 = 54.

items.q: Subtract.
items.e: Ones: 0 − 3 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 10 − 3 = 7. Tens: 6 − 4 = 2. Answer: 27. Check: 27 + 43 = 70. Or count up: 43 + 7 = 50, then 50 + 20 = 70. 7 + 20 = 27.

items.q: What number goes in the box? 47 + ☐ = 65
items.e: Use subtraction: 65 − 47 = ☐. Ones: 5 − 7 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 15 − 7 = 8. Tens: 5 − 4 = 1. Answer: 18. Check: 47 + 18 = 65.

items.q: What number goes in the box? 75 − ☐ = 49
items.e: Think: 75 take away what number leaves 49? Find 75 − 49. Ones: 5 − 9 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 15 − 9 = 6. Tens: 6 − 4 = 2. Answer: 26. Check: 75 − 26 = 49.

items.q: Mateo says 91 − 56 = 35. Is he right?
items.e: Check by adding: 35 + 56 = 91. You get back 91, so he is right. Ones: 1 − 6 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 11 − 6 = 5. Tens: 8 − 5 = 3. Answer: 35.

items.q: Sofia found 81 − 47 = 34. Which addition checks her answer?
items.e: Add the answer to the number you took away: 34 + 47 = 81. You get back 81, so the answer is right.

items.q: What number goes in the box? 91 − ☐ = 66
items.e: Think: 91 take away what number leaves 66? Find 91 − 66. Ones: 1 − 6 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 11 − 6 = 5. Tens: 8 − 6 = 2. Answer: 25. Check: 91 − 25 = 66.

items.q: What is 80 − 24?
items.e: Ones: 0 − 4 needs a regroup. Trade 1 ten for 10 ones: 10 − 4 = 6. Tens: 7 − 2 = 5. Answer: 56. Check: 56 + 24 = 80. Or count up: 24 + 6 = 30, then 30 + 50 = 80. 6 + 50 = 56.
